## Primary-source research

- https://github.com/Ardour/ardour/blob/6.9/libs/ardour/tempo.cc
  MetricSection::add_state_to_node writes pulse, frame, movable, lock-style.
  TempoSection reads legacy start (BBT) and beats-per-minute/note-type;
  tempo-type Constant supplies an equal endpoint, other types imply a ramp.
  MeterSection accepts historical beats-per-bar and divisions-per-bar.
- https://github.com/Ardour/ardour/blob/60b1fb38bd55c5de157ab9b83e8aeaddb03f746b/libs/temporal/tempo.cc
  Point::add_state writes sclock, quarters, bbt. Tempo::get_state writes
  npm/enpm/note-type/type/continuing/locked-to-meter. Meter::get_state writes
  note-value/divisions-per-bar. TempoMap::get_state writes explicit
  superclocks-per-second plus Tempos, Meters, MusicTimes containers.
  MusicTimes are BBT-reset anchors and cannot be silently dropped.
- https://github.com/Ardour/ardour/blob/60b1fb38bd55c5de157ab9b83e8aeaddb03f746b/libs/temporal/beats.cc
  Beats stream serialization is beats:ticks; historical bare doubles are read.
- https://github.com/Ardour/ardour/blob/60b1fb38bd55c5de157ab9b83e8aeaddb03f746b/libs/temporal/temporal/types.h
  ticks_per_beat = 1920.
- https://github.com/Ardour/ardour/blob/60b1fb38bd55c5de157ab9b83e8aeaddb03f746b/libs/temporal/temporal/tempo.h
  quarter_notes_per_minute = npm * 4 / note-type.

## Deliberate scope

Verified against real sessions: historical BBT single-tempo/single-meter maps
at 1|1|0. No claim that all old Ardour sessions are supported.
Implemented experimental subset (explicit allow_experimental=True): modern
constant segments, explicit superclock rate, serialized quarters, integer
bar-aligned meter changes, no MusicTimes. Synthetic tests are labelled;
no licensed real modern tempo-change fixture was located in upstream test tree.
No guessed global clock rate or sample rate. Legacy frame/pulse maps and legacy
BBT changes are rejected; Ardour's conversion/lock semantics are not reproduced.
All ramps are rejected, not converted to the app's linear ramp representation.
No map means an error, never default 120 BPM.

## TDD checkpoint

Interpreter: Python 3.9.6. Runner: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v.

- Availability baseline RED: missing readers.ardour, exit 1. This is NOT semantic
  rejection-test evidence. Minimal real Ardour 3 fixture GREEN: 1 test, exit 0.
- Legacy boundaries RED: 4 tests, 9 failed rejection subcases and 1 error for
  missing historical beats-per-bar support, exit 1. GREEN: 4 tests, exit 0.
- Modern API RED: 7 tests, 1 failure and 18 TypeErrors for missing experimental
  keyword, exit 1. These loader/API errors are NOT independent semantic REDs.
  GREEN: 7 tests (including rejection subcases), exit 0.
- XML/numeric boundaries RED: 11 tests, 3 failed subcases (DTD accepted,
  nested legacy state ignored, extreme meter accepted), exit 1.
  GREEN: 11 tests, exit 0.
- Final GREEN: 14 Ardour tests, exit 0; entire live concurrent suite 76 tests,
  exit 0. Fixture hashes, non-quarter tempo conversion, fractional beats,
  clock-rate scaling, co-located meter/tempo and MIDI export exercised.
  Final raw execution logs retained in scratch/ardour-research/ardour-green.log
  and full-suite.log under the Hermes scratch directory. An earlier full-suite
  run had two transient Studio One failures while another worker was editing;
  no Studio One files were edited here. GUI runner emits pre-existing Qt platform
  warnings. Ardour-specific tests emitted no warnings.

Status: reader UNIT/FIXTURE VERIFIED; Ardour HOST NOT TESTED. Modern maps remain
experimental, opt-in and warning-labelled.

## Integration requirements

Register read_ardour under .ardour in core.READERS and add to GUI file filters.
The module lazily imports core.TempoMap/TempoPoint/ReaderError at call time;
no new model fields/dependencies are needed. Default registration accepts only
verified initial BBT maps. To expose modern step maps, obtain explicit user
opt-in then call read_ardour(path, progress, allow_experimental=True) and surface
TempoMap.warnings. Do not globally enable the flag while hiding warnings.
Rejects missing TempoMap/meter, malformed XML/DTD, inactive tempos, ramps,
nonbinary/fractional meters, nonzero origins, inconsistent positions, mid-bar
meter changes, BBT-reset anchors and unsupported legacy frame/pulse/BBT changes.
Keep these provenance records and upstream COPYING with fixture redistribution.
No core/app/README/workflow files changed; no commits or remote writes.
